shared_engine.note: The engine layer SparkGLM and SparkQwen share, on Atlas-Inf main 7ffd183f: the GLM-5.3-Flash series (port, RC4 commits, tool-call fixes, repeat notice; 236beb90), the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next series (gated by model type, off for GLM; 476e2208), the model-independent SparkQwen RC16 commits (speculation commits serial decode's tokens, one lowest-index greedy tie rule, shared-prefix admission, opt-in loop steering and prefill burst, step trace), the refusal-content fix, batched prefix-cache eviction, the vision prefix cache, and the shared-engine fixes: the w4a16_gemv_qg_batch4 lookup gated to qwen4_exp, sequence-parallel prefill kept with DFlash when its window fits rank 0's half, and ATLAS_MOE_INPLACE_TRANSPOSE (SparkGLM's profiles set 0, the consolidated transpose).
